mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% in a month triggers a risk-off reaction that suppresses equity demand, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-tightening period (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.5% in any month during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) coinciding with UNRATE below 4% predicts stronger consumer demand and positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE < 4% in the preceding month
regime_hint: Labor market strengthening with low unemployment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or not statistically significant (p > 0.05) despite the labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (residential construction) of at least 3% for two consecutive months predicts positive S&P 20-day returns via improved long-term growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or HOUST growth is not sustained for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO (industrial production) index below 105 for three consecutive months signals supply-side weakness, resulting in negative S&P 20-day returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 105 for the 20-day horizon or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by 0.25% over two months while CPIAUCSL is flat, it signals tighter policy and a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% over two months and CPIAUCSL is non-increasing
regime_hint: Gradual policy tightening with stable inflation
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive or FEDFUNDS increase is ≤0.25% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3.5% in a month coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return via improved hiring and consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 3.5% in a single month
regime_hint: Low unemployment and labor market softening
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not cross the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in GDPC1 (GDP) of 2% or more predict negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to market expectations of economic weakness.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive or GDPC1 does not decline by 2% in two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RSAFS (retail sales) by 10% in a month, accompanied by a decline in PAYEMS, predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as it signals strong consumer demand without labor overstretch.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >10% in a month and PAYEMS decreases in the same month
regime_hint: Retail demand surge with moderation in labor market
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the demand-labor interaction is absent.
